comment: Build Install-Runtime's venv/package install from a durable, version-pinned snapshot (New-PluginBuildSnapshot) instead of the live marketplace payload, so a uv/setuptools build subprocess's own CWD no longer blocks copilot plugin update with a Windows file-sharing violation on the default snapshot-based path (the -BestEffort/local-checkout fallback still builds directly from the live payload and keeps that pre-existing exposure).
